data.title: 五和 · 亚得里亚海快艇的破浪御敌
data.description: 意大利威尼斯运河飞驰的快艇甲板上，浪花如雪飞溅。五和双手横持长枪稳稳立在船头抵御魔术冲击，水手短裙被烈风卷起，阳光在水面折射出绚烂彩虹，英勇无畏。
data.location: wooden speedboat cutting through turquoise canal waters past ancient Venetian architecture
data.action: standing balanced on speeding boat bow with lance braced, sea spray splashing, resolute fearless gaze against oncoming magical blasts
data.lighting: 地中海耀眼艳阳与水花漫天耀斑
data.promptProse: Itsuwa stands resolute at the bow of a speeding boat in the Venetian lagoon, lance braced as turquoise spray forms rainbows in the bright Mediterranean sun.
data.animaCaption: Sea spray arcs into a vibrant rainbow beside the speeding boat as she braces her weapon.
